SELECT c.id, cv.title, cv.summary, cv.cover_media_id, cv.cover_url, c.owner_teacher_id AS teacher_id, cv.instructor_display_name AS teacher_display_name, cv.category_id, cat.name AS category_name, cv.level, cv.access_type FROM course c JOIN course_version cv ON cv.id = c.published_version_id JOIN category cat ON cat.id = cv.category_id WHERE ORDER BY c.published_at DESC, c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cv.*, cat.name AS category_name, c.owner_teacher_id FROM course c JOIN course_version cv ON cv.id = c.published_version_id JOIN category cat ON cat.id = cv.category_id WHERE c.id = #{courseId} AND c.publication_status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT cv.*, cat.name AS category_name FROM course_version cv JOIN category cat ON cat.id = cv.category_id WHERE cv.id = #{versionId}
SELECT id, name FROM category WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY name, id
mapper.sql: id, create_request_id, owner_teacher_id, current_draft_version_id, published_version_id, publication_status, published_at, created_at, updated_at, row_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course WHERE id = #{courseId} AND owner_teacher_id = #{teacherId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET current_draft_version_id = #{versionId}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{courseId}

UPDATE course_version SET title = #{version.title}, summary = #{version.summary}, description = #{version.description}, cover_media_id = #{version.coverMediaId}, cover_url = #{version.coverUrl}, instructor_display_name = #{version.instructorDisplayName}, category_id = #{version.categoryId}, level = #{version.level}, access_type = #{version.accessType}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{version.id} AND lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT' AND row_version = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lesson_media_resource WHERE lesson_id IN ( SELECT l.id FROM lesson l JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id WHERE ch.course_version_id = #{versionId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter (id, course_version_id, title, position) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseVersionId}, #{title}, #{position})
INSERT INTO lesson (id, chapter_id, title, lesson_type, position, previewable) VALUES (#{id}, #{chapterId}, #{title}, #{lessonType}, #{position}, #{previewable})
INSERT INTO lesson_media_resource (id, lesson_id, media_id, purpose, position) VALUES (#{id}, #{lessonId}, #{mediaId}, #{purpose}, #{position})
mapper.select: SELECT id, course_version_id, title, position FROM chapter WHERE course_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY position, id
SELECT id, chapter_id, title, lesson_type, position, previewable FROM lesson WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY position, id
SELECT id, lesson_id, media_id, purpose, position FROM lesson_media_resource WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY purpose, position, id

SELECT r.id, r.lesson_id, r.media_id, r.purpose, r.position FROM lesson_media_resource r JOIN lesson l ON l.id = r.lesson_id JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id WHERE ch.course_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY ch.position, l.position, r.purpose, r.position, r.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter WHERE course_version_id = #{versionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter ch WHERE ch.course_version_id = #{versionId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lesson l WHERE l.chapter_id = ch.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE course_version SET lifecycle_status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE id = #{versionId} AND lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE course_version SET lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE id = #{versionId} AND lifecycle_status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE course SET current_draft_version_id = NULL, published_version_id = #{versionId}, publication_status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{courseId}
UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN #{terminal} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, attempts = #{attempts}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING'
